breakdown.description: Mass/volume conservation is violated for steady incompressible flow in constant area (Q cannot change from inlet to outlet).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the physical impossibility in the original prompt. For steady incompressible flow in a constant-area pipe, the volumetric flow rate must be constant. The agent removed the contradictory outlet flow rate (0.02 m^3/s) and specified a single, consistent flow rate for the system (0.01 m³/s), thereby resolving the violation of mass conservation. This aligns with the ground truth's approach of establishing a single, constant flow rate.
